requirements.title: The running Brain answers its health check
requirements.behavior: GET /healthz on the running Brain answers 200.

existing.evidence: server/index.ts serves /healthz; the release verifier already requires it

requirements.title: The program ledger is readable
requirements.behavior: The running Brain can read the factory_program_verifications table.
inputs: the database the running Brain uses

existing.evidence: migrations 140 (SQLite) and 131 (Postgres) create the program tables

requirements.title: The Build page explains when a program is done
requirements.behavior: The Build page shows the sentence: A program of many campaigns is done only when every requirement passes its checks in the running Brain.
outputs: the sentence, in the served client bundle
constraints: one sentence beside the existing campaign hints; no other change to the page

existing.evidence: client/src/russell/Build.tsx already explains how campaigns finish (claimed by the mapper; the running Brain decides)

verification.text: A program of many campaigns is done only when every requirement passes its checks in the running Brain.

requirements.title: A guide to submitting a program
requirements.behavior: docs/FACTORY-PROGRAMS.md explains how to submit a program with factory program-submit, approve it with program-approve, and read it with program-status.
requirements.missingWork: Write docs/FACTORY-PROGRAMS.md naming the three commands and what each does.

requirements.title: The guide stays short
requirements.behavior: docs/FACTORY-PROGRAMS.md is at most 150 lines long.

requirements.title: A checklist for writing a requirement map
requirements.behavior: docs/FACTORY-PROGRAMS-CHECKLIST.md lists every field of a requirement (key, kind, title, subsystem, source, behavior, inputs, outputs, constraints, dependsOn, interactsWith, existing, missingWork, paths, verification, ambiguities) and the seven statuses SPECIFIED, MAPPED, IMPLEMENTED, INTEGRATED, the verified status, BLOCKED and NOT_DONE.

requirements.title: The guide and the checklist find each other
requirements.behavior: docs/FACTORY-PROGRAMS.md links to FACTORY-PROGRAMS-CHECKLIST.md, and the checklist links back to FACTORY-PROGRAMS.md.
requirements.missingWork: Add the link from each document to the other.
